notes.title: July 19th, 2021 Update
notes.notes:
Black Powder Red Earth 8-Bit War ISR Update

The most player-requested feature for 8-Bit War is now up and running. New controls allow gamers to set the movement animation speeds of both assaulters and opponents independently from the options menu. Choose from 1x, 2x 5x or MAX speeds, to determine a pace of play that suits your style!

In addition, players have the option to skip both opponent and friendly movement in-game by tapping the spacebar to fast-forward that unit to its designated final grid, with the game only returning to 1x speed to resolve combat actions.

Look for further quality of life improvements to Black Powder Red Earth 8-Bit War in the coming months as we continue to improve the game.

notes.title: March 23, 2021 Update
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Unforgiving Close Combat in a War-Torn Sprawl
The Campaign Begins[/b][/h3]

[i]Drones fill the airspace over the tangled, war-torn Awbari capital sprawl. In the narrow streets and alleys below, small unit kill teams of private military contractors carry out ruthless targeted killings of jihadists. Each assassination buying the military dictatorship another day of viability — ensuring the flow of natural resources out of the country.[/i]

The 8-Bit War Campaign is a string of 12 single-player story-driven missions, complete with cut scenes designed and produced in the style of the Black Powder Red Earth® graphic novels and Hypernotes. Isolating minute-to-minute decision-making, players hunt down three high-value targets, operational emirs of the jihadist Shadow Emirate, with full lethal authority. 

Find, fix and finish.

Step into the event horizon of absolute chaos. Now.

notes.title: February 18th, 2021 Update
notes.notes:
[b]The 8-Bit War, Remixed[/b]

Glowing cinders waft down, falling off pillars of smoke hanging over the war torn sprawl of the Awbari capital. Kill teams of private military contractors patrol the narrow streets and alleys, fighting as the agents of a military dictatorship against a violent extremist insurgency.

Immerse yourself deeper into the tangled war-torn slums with new sound design, voice cues and a complete re-mix of the game audio. Step into the event horizon of absolute chaos - Black Powder Red Earth® 8-bit War is closing in on our final update before the game leaves early access and becomes a full release.

notes.title: January 4th, 2021 Update
notes.notes:
[b]Speed Is Security[/b]
The Black Powder | Red Earth® Turn Based Tactics tutorial is finally here. Covering mobility, navigation, capabilities, combat and mission completion, the tutorial teaches both the controls of the game, and the thinking that will inform your tactics.

+ Speed is security
+ Don't fight the whole city
+ Distance favors the marksman
+ Never go into a gunfight with only one gun

Gather intelligence and maneuver your kinetic forces to conduct lethal actions with minimal exposure. Step into the event horizon of chaos, now.

notes.title: December 14th 2020 Update
notes.notes:
OPERATOR TIME
Cevian Signature is 50 square meters of war torn ghetto. A known safe haven for jihadist fighters where every garbage-choked sliver threading through the sprawl holds potential compromise. Senior leadership of the Shadow Emirate shelter in the cinderblock structures, where only small unit kill teams can maneuver. Extract vital human assets, conduct high value target kill raids, or evacuate safe houses under massed attacks with extreme prejudice. Step in the event horizon of absolute chaos.

notes.title: ROADMAP
notes.notes:
0300. Drones fill the airspace over the war-torn capital city of Awbari. In the sprawl below, small unit kill teams from private military contractor Cold Harbor carry-out targeted killings of jihadist extremists in the name of the failing state's current dictatorship. An unending war between the lines, punctuated by suppressed muzzle reports and suicide vests clacking off in the pitch black.

After more than 3 years of development, [b]Black Powder Red Earth 8-bit War[/b] is 120 days from completion. This is the roadmap.

[b]Next 30 days[/b]
Design Team Ember will drop [b]Cevian Signature[/b] — the sixth and final operations area for the game.

[b]Next 60 days[/b]
Tutorial will be complete. It should be done sooner, but 60 days for sure.

[b]Next 90 days[/b]
All foley and sound effects will be replaced with a completely redesigned package that was completed in October, 2020.

[b]Next 120 days[/b]
A campaign was never part of the original plan but by popular demand, we've got one coming. 

[b]Hypernotes Ember + Steam Key Bundle[/b]
With the completion of our project drawing near, _Echelon Software is launching a package on our website that pairs an all-in-one Steam key for Windows, Mac and Linux (priced 30% off) with our hardcover art + lore book, Black Powder Red Earth® Hypernotes Ember.

Hypernotes Ember is hardcover bound, full color, made-in-USA book with over 40 pages of fully illustrated background info plus an original 50 page short story comic. Crafted with the assistance of the same special operations combat veterans who helped create the Black Powder Red Earth® Yemen mini-series, Hypernotes Ember is deep dive into the world of BPRE detailing factions, weapon systems, PPE, unit organizations and a comprehensive background history of the failing state of Awbari!

Pick up the package today at https://www.blackpowderredearth.com/games.php

notes.title: The 8-Bit War has Intensified
notes.notes:
Extremist violence has spread further through the slums of Awbari City, twisting the disaffected with fervor and bloodlust. Contract kill teams from Private Military Contractor Cold Harbor have been engaged to suppress this insurgency with full lethal authority.

In this latest update, Design Team Ember has added content, additional depth and significant polish! 

[b]Two New Operations Areas[/b]
Locust Pilgrim and Obsolete Torch are now LIVE! Supporting raid and exfil operations, as well as high profile attack evacuation missions, every map is populated with a random variety of local nationals and extremist fighters unique to every game.

[b]Redesigned UI[/b]
We’ve overhauled the entire UI of the game to put core game actions and new combat capabilities at your fingertips.

[b]Deeper Behavior and Response[/b] 
The Military Aged Males (MAMs) present in the Operations Area now have a range of additional actions they can take in response to player actions. Aware of other MAMs, they will respond not only to actions that affect them but other local nationals as well.

[b]Kinetic Interrupt Capability[/b]
Counter ambushing extremist fighters gives affected assaulters one chance to avoid a kinetic event, making placement and positioning more important than ever.

[b]Send a Text Capability[/b]
A non-lethal means to temporarily distract and disable both local nationals and extremist fighters.

[b]High Card Flush[/b]
To avoid a fight in the house, kinetic force commanders can now opt to drop the HVT structure when the assaulters have positively identified the Named Area of Interest. Be advised, employing drones will create an immediate compromise and the kinetic force will have to fight their way to a designated exfil.

Conduct surreptitious movements into non-permissive environments and re-establish order with extreme prejudice. The 8-Bit War continues. Absolute Chaos. Now.

[b]Hypernotes Ember[/b]
Just released and now available on the BPRE website, Hypernotes Ember. Filled with artwork, lore and an exclusive narrative depicting an Ember operation, this full color 92 page hardcover is a must-have for fans of the game. Printed in the USA on responsibly sourced archival quality materials, pick up your copy here http://www.blackpowderredearth.com/merch_graphic_novels.php
